parameters.query:
WITH delete_scenes AS (
  DELETE FROM video_scenes WHERE video_id = $1
), delete_links AS (
  DELETE FROM video_links WHERE video_id = $1 AND produced_by = 'gemini'
), insert_scenes AS (
  INSERT INTO video_scenes (video_id, start_sec, end_sec, description, on_screen_text, keywords)
  SELECT $1, x.start_sec, x.end_sec, x.description, x.on_screen_text, x.keywords
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb)
       AS x(start_sec int, end_sec int, description text, on_screen_text text, keywords text)
  RETURNING 1
), insert_links AS (
  INSERT INTO video_links (video_id, at_sec, url, source, context, produced_by)
  SELECT $1, x.at_sec, x.url, x.source, x.context, 'gemini'
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb)
       AS x(at_sec int, url text, source text, context text)
  RETURNING 1
), mark_done AS (
  UPDATE livestreams SET visual_analyzed_at = now() WHERE video_id = $1
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT $1 AS video_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM insert_scenes) AS scene_count,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM insert_links) AS link_count;

nodes.name: Save scenes & links
nodes.notes: Credential: Postgres livestream (write). Replaces this video's scene log and Gemini links in one statement; links found by OCR (produced_by = 'ocr') are kept.

parameters.content:
## Livestream visual analysis
1. The video must already be ingested with workflow 1 (its duration is needed) and be **public**.
2. Split into 10-minute chunks → Gemini watches each chunk (1 frame/second, with audio).
3. Save the scene log to `video_scenes` and links to `video_links`.

Re-running on the same video replaces its Gemini data (OCR links are kept). Change the model in the Gemini node URL.
**Credentials:** Postgres livestream (write), Gemini (Header Auth `x-goog-api-key`).
